We are looking for an experienced Structural Analysis Specialist (CAE Engineer) with strong expertise in FEA and Abaqus to support design verification and optimization. · Core Skills: Strong fundamentals in FEA, Strength of Materials, and Theory of Machines.

· Tools Expertise:

· Mandatory: Abaqus (advanced level – non-linear analysis) & Recurdyn (MBD)

· Preferred: ANSYS (vibration analysis – optional)

· Meshing: Hypermesh (2D midsurface & 3D tetra/hex meshing)

· Proven experience in structural analysis, durability studies, and failure investigation.

· Ability to interpret simulation results, identify issues, and recommend design improvements.

· Exposure to structural optimization techniques and performance enhancement methods.

· Background from reputed MNCs preferred.

· Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and reporting skills.

Excellent communication (verbal & written) and stakeholder management skills.
